summaries.Romania: Romania faces an unprecedented energy crisis as the Danube River reaches historic lows, forcing nuclear reactor shutdowns and emergency military interventions to maintain power supply. Extreme heat waves across the country have intensified the situation, with temperatures expected to reach 38-41°C this week.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation continues with significant funding rounds and AI integration across providers, while regulatory pressures mount on telehealth companies and cost-control measures reshape insurance and pharmaceutical models.
summaries.Tech: Apple's new Upgrade program reshapes device ownership models, while AI developments accelerate across industries—from autonomous vehicles to content creation—amid ongoing debates about responsible deployment and user impact.

items.line: Romania's energy security is threatened as Danube water levels hit historic minimums, forcing Cernavodă nuclear reactor shutdown and emergency military detonations to divert river flow.

items.title: Apple Upgrade might’ve provided our first hint for what could change with Apple Card
items.snippet:
This week, Apple launched Apple Upgrade, its new leasing program for most Apple products. It replaces the iPhone Upgrade Program entirely, and for the most part, it’s an incredible deal.
The deal is so good that largely, there isn’t a great reason to use Apple Card Monthly Installments (ACMI) anymor
items.line: Apple's new Upgrade program fundamentally shifts iPhone ownership from purchase to subscription, potentially reshaping device financing and making monthly installments obsolete.

items.title: CMS locks in 2.3% inpatient hospital base pay increase, nudges back CJR-X Model start date
items.snippet: The Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) final rule's base pay increase is slightly below what was proposed earlier this year, though the agency said it now expects the rule's changes to bring hospital payments hundreds of millions of dollars higher than its prior projection.
items.line: CMS locks in modest 2.3% inpatient hospital base pay increase while reshaping reimbursement models, signaling continued pressure on hospital margins despite inflation.

items.title: Function Health lands $450M in growth financing to scale tech-enabled preventive health
items.snippet: Function Health, a company that offers lab testing and body scans for early disease detection, landed $450 million in growth financing to scale its tech-enabled personalized preventive health services.
items.line: Function Health raises $450M for tech-enabled preventive care platform, reflecting growing investor confidence in early disease detection and personalized health models.

items.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers over data privacy, billing practices
items.snippet: The Federal Trade Commission, along with Utah and California authorities, sued telehealth company Hims & Hers, alleging it misled consumers about privacy, billing and subscription practices.
items.line: FTC sues Hims & Hers over data privacy and billing practices, escalating regulatory scrutiny of telehealth companies' consumer protection obligations.

items.title: Should you still buy your next smartphone — or subscribe to it instead?
items.snippet: Apple's new Upgrade program is the latest sign that smartphone ownership is changing.
items.line: Smartphone subscription services are becoming mainstream with Apple's Upgrade program, challenging traditional ownership models across the industry.
